important_boundary: Numerical signal thresholds are intentionally not defined here. This layer calculates auditable evidence intensity and convergence inputs for calibration.

outcomes.name: Energy & Vitality
outcomes.rule: Do not create a signal from Q01 alone. Prefer convergence of energy/fatigue evidence with sleep/recovery or physical-capacity evidence.

outcomes.name: Sleep & Recovery
outcomes.rule: A primary sleep/recovery response can create a candidate signal; stronger signals require convergent evidence.

outcomes.name: Digestive & Gut Health
outcomes.rule: Use symptom/dietary convergence. Medical history, treatment and sensitivity context never increase signal strength.

outcomes.name: Healthy Weight & Metabolic Balance
outcomes.rule: Avoid inferring metabolic problems from a single dietary behaviour.

outcomes.name: Mood, Stress & Emotional Balance
outcomes.rule: Multiple direct experiential responses can legitimately form a strong signal; remain non-diagnostic.

outcomes.name: Immune Resilience
outcomes.rule: Prefer convergence of recurring illness/resilience/recovery responses.

outcomes.name: Hormonal & Life-Stage Balance
outcomes.rule: Conditional output only where relevant; never imply a hormonal diagnosis.

outcomes.name: Mobility, Joints & Physical Function
outcomes.rule: Use physical-function experience plus activity context.

outcomes.name: Respiratory Health
outcomes.rule: Q45 is the clearest direct symptom evidence. Exposure/context can corroborate but is not a diagnosis.

outcomes.name: Circulation & Cardiovascular Fitness
outcomes.rule: Convergence-based outcome. Do not create a strong signal from a single indirect exposure.
